newsitem.title: USA: Phillips says Texas refinery seen back in 2-6 days.
newsitem.headline: Phillips says Texas refinery seen back in 2-6 days.

text.p: Phillips Petroleum Co said its Sweeny, Texas refinery should return to normal operations within two to six days, slightly longer than first expected, after a power outage shut the 205,000 barrel per day refinery last week.
Several units have been restarted, but the company's new time estimate to return to normal operations added about three days to earlier estimates.
"Slowly but surely we're bringing it up," said Melissa Durossette, company spokeswoman.
The power outage hit region May 13, halting all operations at the facility.
Ethylene and natural gas liquids processing units remained in the early stage of start-up, Durossette said.
